title_sq: Shitet apartament 1+1 te ish Fusha e Aviacionit
description_sq:
Apartament 1+1 te ish Fusha e Aviacionit!
Ofrohet per shitje apartament i tipologjise 1+1 ne nje objekt ne faze ndertimi te ish Fusha e Aviacionit!
Apartament ka siperfaqe totale 82.48 m2 bruto dhe 71.72 m2 siperfaqe neto.
Planimetria eshte e rregullt dhe plotesisht e shfrytezueshme. Organizohet ne ambient dite dhe dhome gjumi me dalje ne ballkon, dhe nje tualet.
Objekti dorezohet per 3 vite.
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in the former Aviation Field
description_en: 1+1 apartment in the former Aviation Field! A 1+1 typology apartment is offered for sale in a building in the construction phase of the former Aviation Field! The apartment has a total area of ​​82.48 m2 gross and 71.72 m2 net area. The layout is regular and fully usable. It is organized in a living room and a bedroom with access to the balcony, and a toilet. The facility is delivered for 3 years.
